summary: The Kerberos V5 GSS-API mechanism (RFC 4121) hashes channel bindings with MD5. This RFC updates it so the algorithm can be negotiated using the Kerberos crypto framework of RFC 3961, and notes this uses the last extensible field in the client-server exchange.

eli5.summary: Kerberos used one old fingerprint method to tie a login to a connection. This lets it pick a newer, stronger fingerprint method instead.

questions: replace md5 in kerberos channel bindings
